{{Quote|I'm sorry, I can't rescue your brother from the narkaa. I left my hero suit in the cabin.|Han Solo, joking about his children investigating the ''Just Cause'' wreckage|<ref name="SOL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Just Cause''''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|starfreighter]] that crashed in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]]'s western [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]].<ref name="SOL" /> According to legend, the ''Just Cause'' sank 900 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] deep with schools of [[narkaa]] guarding its cargo of precious metals.<ref name="CWSE" /> In [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]],<ref name="VacayDate">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' dated the events of the [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] vacation to twelve years after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dated [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], therefore the ''Just Cause's'' sinking occurred before [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].</ref> [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] told his children about the lost ship on a [[Solo family/Legends|family]] vacation to [[Illafian Point]]'s beaches.<ref name="SOL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Just Cause'' was first mentioned in the [[1996]] novel ''[[Shield of Lies]]'', written by [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]].<ref name="SOL"/>
